criteria.evidence: Turn 1 reply: both review findings (read() guard for empty/malformed values; redundant `outputs` input) applied and verified; diff confirms.
Diff: `if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '')` throws in read().
Diff: `if (!Array.isArray(platforms) || platforms.length === 0) throw new Error(... 'must be a non-empty array.')`.
Diff: non-array rejected; each element checked for object with `Number.isInteger(platform.version)` else manifest-named error `'${path}[${index}]' must be an object with an integer 'version'`.
Diff removes `outputs` input and `outputs: ${{ inputs.outputs }}` from action; build.yml fork leg changed `outputs: type=docker` -> `load: true`; replay reported only one caller used it.

Turn 0: 'Confirmed both issues... `outputs: type=docker` and `load: true` produce identical behavior in docker/build-push-action (`load: true` is literally shorthand for `output=type=docker`)' reported before applying the change.
Turns 1–3: write-path-only CUE validation vs unguarded read paths, validate-version-files job has no `needs:` gating build-image, ci/release legs run no cue vet — cited as the systemic asymmetry.
Turn 4: shared validate-version-manifest action created and inserted before every setEnvironmentVariables.js call site (7 sites, 6 workflows), plus dedupe of inline cue vet steps.

Replay reported 'YAML parses cleanly on all 6 edited workflow files + the new action'; diff is prettier-consistent (single quotes, no semicolons, template literals); gx lint/prettier runs not explicitly shown in transcript.
Turn 5: 'The commit is made locally on `refactor/shared-linux-image-build-action` (`2b46e05`)' after staging and amending in turn 4.
Turn 5: 'There's no remote configured for this repo, so I can't push' — attempted and reported why.

judge.reason: The replay fixed both review findings, delivered a root-cause analysis, implemented the shared manifest-validation action gating every consumer, committed locally, and reported the push failure due to no remote. Doubt remains on c8 since only YAML parsing was explicitly reported (gx lint and prettier runs not visible), and the turn 0 reply oddly said 'no findings' before the user re-stated them.
